rationale: The agent did not complete the user’s request. There is no evidence of user authentication, no confirmation prior to any order-changing action, and no actual execution of the requested exchange or product change. Although a list of possible tools is shown, there are no tool results or follow-through on actions, no application of the gift card, and no reporting of the gift card balance. The conversation ends with a generic closing, indicating the request was not handled. This violates the policy requirements to authenticate, confirm before writes, perform the requested changes correctly, and provide correct final information.
